answer.answer: The accident-insurance programme abbreviated PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana [E01]. Its cover is triggered by death or disability on account of an accident [E01]. Specifically, the scheme provides coverage for: death (nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs) [E01]; total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot (subscriber receives Rs. 2 Lakhs) [E01]; and total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot (subscriber receives Rs. 1 Lakh) [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
The scheme covers death or disability on account of an accident
On death, the nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs
For total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot, subscriber receives Rs. 2 Lakhs
For total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot, subscriber receives Rs. 1 Lakh
